## Video Forge in plain English

Video Forge is a Windows app for making videos where characters talk.
You write what they say. You pick a voice for each one.
The app makes the video, with subtitles, in Greek or English.

### What it does

- **Guides you in.** **Create** asks one thing at a time: the style, the characters, the background, the kind of video. Every choice is shown with your own characters.
- **Many kinds of characters.** 21 drawn styles (from stick figures to Greek shadow theatre), picture puppets made in Image Forge, and Kenney's 3D people and pets. Drawn ones walk in, sit, wave and point when the script says so.
- **Voices, free or paid.** Gemini and Fish Audio are free. Piper runs on your own computer with no internet. ElevenLabs is paid, and the app shows the cost and asks before it spends.
- **Mouths that move with the words.** Nine mouth shapes follow the voice. Question marks raise the eyebrows.
- **Subtitles that follow the voice.** The word being said lights up in the speaker's colour. Subtitle files (`.srt`, `.vtt`) come with every video.
- **Sounds good on its own.** Studio sound cleans the voices and sets the loudness YouTube expects. Voices can sit a little left or right. A colour grade is optional.
- **One script, many videos.** Make a tall, square, portrait or wide copy. Get the same video in the other language. Or fill a spreadsheet, one row per video, and it makes them all.
- **Honest label.** "Made with Video Forge" sits in a corner, on by default.

### Your first video

1. Install the app and open it.
2. Press the gear (top right) and paste a free Gemini key. Press **Save**, then **Test**.
3. Press **Create**. Pick a style, add two characters, and give each a voice.
4. Pick a background and a format, like **Two people talking**.
5. On **Review**, press **Go to production**.
6. Write a few lines, each as `Name: words`.
7. Press **Make the narration**, then play the preview.
8. Press **Quick draft** to check it, then **Render video**.

### Good to know

- **Your keys stay on your computer.** They are locked with your computer's password store. They only go to the service they belong to.
- **The video is made on your computer.** Your script only goes to the services you choose: the voice, and the AI if you ask it to write or translate.
- **It needs a strong computer.** An NVIDIA graphics card with 8 GB and 32 GB of memory are recommended. A 10-minute video takes about an hour to make.
- **Windows warns you the first time.** The app is not code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Two versions.** The public build is for everyone. The owner's personal build adds his own characters, music and the 3D Humans, which cannot be shared.
- **The licence.** It is free to use, even for paid work. It is source available, not open source. The one rule: every video you publish credits "Made with Video Forge - https://stravelakis.com/forge".

The full manual is below: **Install**, then the **Guide**.
